name: Stacked! Quality Pancakes "The Purist" Stack (Buttermilk or Gluten/Dairy-Free Mod)
searchKeywords: gluten free dairy free pancakes logan utah
whyItWorks: Downtown Logan's dedicated pancake house can make "The Purist" plain pancake stack either classic buttermilk or both gluten-friendly and dairy-free upon request, paired with scrambled eggs for easy morning fuel.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order "The Purist" pancake stack (request the dairy-free / gluten-friendly batter if lactose-sensitive) with warm maple syrup and a side of scrambled eggs.
watchOuts: Standard buttermilk batter and whipped butter contain dairy unless you request the dairy-free preparation; skip lemon curd or seedy berry compotes
